# React Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > React

## Overview

Writes comprehensive tests for React applications using React Testing Library, Jest, and MSW for reliable component and integration testing

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [react-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
react-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@react-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write user-centric tests with Testing Library queries
- Mock API calls with MSW handlers
- Test async operations with waitFor and findBy queries
- Implement custom render functions with providers

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Testing Library**: User-centric testing philosophy and query priorities
- **MSW**: Mock Service Worker for API mocking best practices
- **Accessibility Testing**: Automated a11y testing with jest-axe
